description: Image Description: A dark brown horse with a black mane and tail stands in a stable aisle, wearing a blue and pink horse rug that covers its body. The rug appears slightly worn, with visible stains and signs of use. The horse is secured to the wall by a braided rope halter, which is attached to a metal ring on the beige brick wall. The horse has a bridle on its head, and its front hooves are clean and dark, while the back hooves appear lighter
